handoff_regions.name: Clinical team to social worker handoff
handoff_regions.handoff_summary: The discharge case appears to move from the clinical ward team to a social worker for post-discharge support planning.

from_party.party_detail: Ward team responsible for clinical discharge preparation
from_party.context_description: Prepares the patient case before post-discharge support planning.

to_party.party_detail: Role responsible for social and post-discharge support planning
to_party.context_description: Receives the case to assess and arrange support needs.

handoff_regions.transferred_responsibility_or_control: Responsibility for assessing or arranging post-discharge social support moves from the clinical ward team to the social worker.
handoff_regions.sender_expected_action: Prepare and send the discharge support request with the relevant clinical and social information.
handoff_regions.receiver_expected_action: Review the request and arrange the required post-discharge support.
handoff_regions.why_candidate: The flow appears to move from clinical discharge preparation to a different responsible party for post-discharge support planning.

confirmation_questions.question: Should post-discharge follow-up be included inside the parent workflow or treated as downstream?
confirmation_questions.why_needed: This affects the end boundary of the parent workflow.
